checkpoint.title: From Wild Zone 1's gate into the Research Lab

events.why: face the street by the minimap arrow (257), down it 6.5 s, left into the lab's gate (walk_to_marker sticks on the fence), held until Ryon's dialog, which shows 9-11 s after the marker goes, hence 13 s
Ryon at the lab gate; with five species he goes on, and a black fade puts the player at the lab's steps (~20 s)
until control; at once when research_lab_gate played the whole scene. Bare: "a" would wait 45 s for a scene
up the steps to the lab's "A Enter"; the marker's digits do not read on the steps, so the prompt counts unless digits over 20 were read
A Enter, the receptionist; autosave. The fade comes 0.5 s after A, so 3 s of control with no scene means not at the door
no run saw the lobby's autosave, so a menu save for 03.10's start

metadata.source: played from a new game; starts just outside Wild Zone 1's far gate; ends in the lab lobby with a menu save
